seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player: arrows move 3 cells; blocked by portal bbox and frame colours 2/15 (cells under drawn objects treated as open).
Kick: destination overlapping a block pushes a chain 1 cell/tick (absorbing touched blocks) until colour 2, bound, player, or non-fitting socket interior (inset 1).
Click on block: player takes its rect, block removed; tokens renamed token_i by (y,x). Targets/portal static.
Step 55 gap = level reset; handled statelessly.
Unconfirmed: fitting-socket fill, A5/A7 (no-op), clicks off blocks (no-op).
